name: anndata
description: AnnData is a third-party annotated-matrix component primitive for single-cell and other high-dimensional biological data. Use it when creating, reading, writing, subsetting, concatenating, or validating .h5ad and .zarr objects that will be shared with Scanpy, scvi-tools, or related scverse tools.
capabilities: Create and inspect annotated matrices with X, obs, var, layers, obsm, varm, obsp, varp, uns, and raw.
Read and write native h5ad and zarr formats, plus common tabular and matrix-style inputs.
Concatenate, subset, and transform annotated data while preserving metadata alignment.
Provide the shared data container used by Scanpy and scvi-tools workflows.
requirements: Optional scanpy for 10x Genomics and other non-native input readers.
Enough memory for the matrix size or backed storage when needed.
